title: Vanilluxe
description: A Vanilla+ modpack for 1.21.1, bringing improved performance, terrain generation, aesthetics, and many useful utilities!
body:
A Vanilla+ modpack for 1.21.1, bringing improved performance, terrain generation, aesthetics, and many useful utilities!

With [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) and [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic), terrain generation is vastly improved! Explore the world with a few bits and bobs from [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra)! With [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), you can see the beautiful terrain and structures! This is further improved by [Complementary Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)! Truly, the most beautiful way to see Minecraft.

But that's not all! Performance mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) (for rendering) and [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) (for game logic) bring your FPS to new heights! Maybe enough to counter the effects of Distant Horizons and Shaders??

Finally, I have included resource packs from [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)! These include:
* More Zombies
* Various Retro MC Resources
* Unobtrusive Utilities
* Various Aesthetics (mostly my personal preferences)
* Some 3D Textures
* Consistency and General Fixes

## Vanilla Incompatibility
Most mods in this pack were chosen to be compatible with Vanilla clients. However, one major choice prevented compatibility - that being [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport), which brings features from 1.21.4 and 1.21.8 to 1.21.1 (namely, The Garden Awakens and Chase the Skies). Due to this major compatibility breaker, I added a few more non-compatible mods:
* Fast Paintings
* Staaaaaaaaaaaack (Stxck)
* Trash Slot

Besides those listed, all mods *should* work with Vanilla clients. Feel free to remove the incompatible mods and use on a server :)
